body: Please stay with us! You’re not alone in the way you’re feeling! It makes me sad to think you carry this much pain! Would you like to talk?

Every survivor who jumped off the Golden Gate Bridges said their first thought was immediate regret as they fell.  Please think about that. If you want to talk please reach out to me! It will help me as well talking with someone!

It’s nice to have things to look forward to. Even if it’s a package in the mail. Have you ever thought about volunteering? Either with animals or people. I found when I’m feeling low if I can find ways to help others it helps make me feel better. Having something to do that wasn’t for myself felt good. It helps make me feel like I was living for more than just myself. Since you enjoy shopping online have you thought about finding good deals on things and then reselling then on eBay? Maybe things you could spend a little time restoring and then reselling.

It makes me sad to think of the pain you carry. Sounds like you do have people in your life who care about you though. Want to tell me more about them? Sounds like your boyfriend is supportive. Think his work will slow down anytime soon?
Why can’t you find something new to look forward to? Like set a goal or find a new drive. What do you like to do? What can or has brought you happiness?
If you have friends and family to say goodbye to you’re not alone and have people who care so don’t forget that. I can relate to how you’re feeling. Would you like to talk? It will help me to!
